faq.question: Do you offer specialized care for wedding dresses and gowns?
faq.answer: Yes, we provide comprehensive cleaning, delicate restoration, and archival preservation services for bridal and formal wear to ensure your memories last a lifetime.

faq.question: Are your cleaning solvents environmentally friendly?
faq.answer: We utilize modern, highly filtered cleaning technologies that are exceptionally gentle on your clothes while meeting strict environmental standards for safety and sustainability.

faq.question: Can you remove set-in oil or wine stains?
faq.answer: Our stain specialists evaluate every single garment before treatment. While we cannot promise the removal of every historical stain, our advanced pretreatment processes successfully lift the vast majority of challenging marks.

faq.question: Do you offer alterations along with dry cleaning?
faq.answer: We provide essential minor repairs such as button replacements, securing loose threads, and minor hem adjustments. Please point out needed repairs to our staff at drop-off.
